correctness.rationale: For independent fair orientations, the indicator covariance vanishes at nonadjacent distinct vertices, equals -4^{-d(v)} on the diagonal and 2^{-d(u)-d(v)} for each ordered adjacent source/sink pair. Summation yields C(T)=2 Σ_edges 2^{-d(u)-d(v)}−Σ_vertices4^{-d(v)}. Completion of squares gives Σ_v(d(v)−1)4^{-d(v)}−Σ_edges(2^{-d(u)}−2^{-d(v)})². A leaf-count bound gives deficit ≥1/4 for ≥4 leaves; exactly 3 leaves forces one cubic vertex, with at least 3/64 of cubic-edge energy beyond 3/16 leaf energy, and deficit ≥13/64. Equality iff all three cubic neighbors have degree 2, equivalently all three spider arms have length at least 2; path alone reaches (n−4)/16. The algebra establishes all n≥3. Independently enumerated nonisomorphic trees through 8 vertices and all orientations through 6; finite checks only corroborate.
